description:
A .NET wrapper library for FFmpeg using FFmpeg.AutoGen. This library provides a managed interface for FFmpeg's raw C API by wrapping around the unsafe pointers and structs provided by FFmpeg.AutoGen. It offers a higher-level, object-oriented approach to access and manipulate FFmpeg's core functionality, making it easier to integrate FFmpeg into .NET applications.

Simplifies working with FFmpeg by providing a safer, managed wrapper around the native FFmpeg API.

Exposes FFmpeg's powerful multimedia processing capabilities in a more accessible, object-oriented format.

Reduces the need to work directly with pointers and memory management, leveraging the safety of C# for easier debugging and development.

Ideal for .NET developers who need to integrate FFmpeg's audio and video processing, transcoding, streaming, and encoding/decoding capabilities in their applications.

--- 8.1.2.12 ---
			BugFix: MediaSource.SetCodecContext did not set the time base.
			BugFix: SetOption(...,Dictionary,...) now removes all set options.			
			--- 8.1.2.11 ---
			BugFix: EventHandler BeginInvoke is not supported.
			--- 8.1.2.10 ---
			BugFix: CancellableWorkItem would still perform the action if canceled.
			FFmpeg.Helper.Exceptions include now static extenstions for easy throwing, especially under .netstandard (e.g. ObjectDisposeException.ThrowIfTrue(bool,this))
			--- 8.1.2.9 ---
			Added FFmpegWorkQueue, a concurrency-limited work queue for asynchronous FFmpeg operations.
			Supports cancellable send/receive operations for codecs and filters, hardware frame reception, arbitrary FFmpeg work such as seeking, configurable concurrency, and synchronous/asynchronous disposal.
			CancellableWorkItem operations can be awaited directly.
			--- 8.1.2.8 ---
			BugFix: Peek samples calculation missing "/ Channels"
			BugFix: FilterGraph Copy ignores auto_ filters. Added Flush().
			BugFix: AVResult.ThrowIfError now throws if error is TryAgain
			Added class FFmpeg.Collections.CircularArray<T>
			Added MediaPlayer namespace for easy MediaPlayer implementation (see example project 9.)
			--- 8.1.2.7 ---
			Readme fixed
			--- 8.1.2.6 ---
			FFmpegDotNet._AutoGen was not build against FFmpeg 8.1.2 but master - FFmpeg 9.0 (pre)
			--- 8.1.2.5 ---
			Reworked filtering
			Removed dupplicated function in filters, moved FilterContext Create[Filter] function in Audio/VideoFilters.
			Documentation
			Some BugFixes in FilterGraph

			--- 8.1.2.4 ---
			BugFix: FormatContext.WritePacket wrote interleaved packets previously.
			BugFix/full implementation: MediaSink is now fully implemented, some bugs got fixed
			BugFix: SwsContext copies now into "readonly" AVFrame
			BugFix: SwsContext does create a Buffer if the frame does not have one. The plane pointers are fetched after the buffer was created
			--- 8.1.2.3 ---
			XML Docu no in nuget package
			Support for custom audio channel layout
			AudioFifo-Bugfix
			Some smaller changes
			--- 8.1.2.2 ---
			Added namespace FFmpeg.Logging for logging.
			--- 8.1.2.1 ---
			MediaSource now copies the streams timebase into the CodecContexts timebase.
			The CodecContexts timebase is writen into the frame if the  frame's timebase's numerator is 0.
			=== 8.1.2 ===
			Update to ffmpeg 8.1.2 "Hoarse".
			FormatContext was split into DemuxerContext and MuxerContext.
			MediaSource no longer thread-safe. It doesn't make sense to make it thread-safe as most of the time it will only be called from one thread.
